title: Create funders dialog component
acceptance_criteria: Component accepts props: open, onOpenChange, totalAmount, funders (array), onFundersChange
Company header displays company name from app_settings and covers full total by default
Funder list shows each funder with name and amount using NumberInput display
Add funder section uses LiveSearch for funder selection + NumberInput for amount
Real-time calculation shows company contribution = totalAmount - sum(funders.amount)
Remove funder button (X) for each listed funder
Follows existing dialog and component patterns from SO page
